story.titleZh: 安东内利蒙扎逆转夺冠，末段超越拉塞尔
story.summaryZh: 在F1意大利大奖赛中，安东内利从第19位发车，最终在比赛末段超越队友拉塞尔夺冠，维斯塔潘获得第三。
story.originalTitle: Antonelli completes winning Monza recovery with late Russell pass
story.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid, overtaking his Mercedes team-mate George Russell late on, with Max Verstappen finishing third.
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在蒙扎势不可挡，他从发车格第19位起步，赢得了F1意大利大奖赛的冠军，领先于梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔和红牛的维斯塔潘。
在夏尔·勒克莱尔于第二圈末尾撞车退赛并引发红旗之前，安东内利已经上升了七个位置。比赛重启后，安东内利继续保持强势，一路冲到前方，与拉塞尔多次交换位置，两位梅赛德斯车手为领先而战。
但这位积分榜领跑者获得了一个关键优势：在第28圈末尾，当他处于第二位时，在虚拟安全车情况下进站——而梅赛德斯选择不让拉塞尔这么做。
尽管一度冲出赛道，安东内利还是在比赛尾声夺取了领先，成为自1966年以来首位在蒙扎赢得主场赛事的意大利车手。
维斯塔潘同样在虚拟安全车期间进站，整场比赛一直紧追梅赛德斯的两位车手，最终登上领奖台获得第三名。
杆位起步的加斯利最终毫无还手之力，为阿尔派车队获得第七名。
在勒克莱尔撞车引发红旗期间，安东内利是少数几位在重启时选择中性胎而非硬胎的车手之一——而他初次发车时使用的是硬胎。
比赛在第六圈重启，安东内利当时排在第12位。他在几圈之内就上升到第六位，到第14圈时他已经追近了拉塞尔与维斯塔潘之间的领跑争夺战。
到第16圈时，拉塞尔已经重新超过维斯塔潘夺回领先位置，而在那一圈，安东内利也从这位四届世界冠军手中抢走了第二名——后者此前报告说他的后轴"完全坏了"。
随后，安东内利和拉塞尔展开了一场类似F1 2026风格的来回争夺领先权的较量，直到大约第22圈，工程师皮特·博宁顿告诉安东内利"别再拉锯了"，随后进一步解释说，这是为了让拉塞尔有时间拉开与身后维斯塔潘的差距。
安东内利被告知："如果他做不到，我们就交换位置。"
车队指令的难题在第28圈被暂时搁置，因为兰斯·斯特罗尔的阿斯顿·马丁停车引发了虚拟安全车（VSC）。安东内利和维斯塔潘分别进站换上了中性胎和硬胎——而拉塞尔则留在场上，小心翼翼地使用硬胎坚持到比赛结束。
这两位进站的车手分别从第六和第七位起步，轻松超越了身前的赛车。到第37圈时，安东内利已经将落后差距缩小到距领先者10秒以内；到第47圈时，他已经逼近到只差1秒。
在第53圈中的第49圈，安东内利试图在第一个减速弯角从拉塞尔手中夺走领先位置，但操作失误，冲进了砂石区，损失了1.4秒。
车队告诉继续领跑的拉塞尔：“保持干净，这里不要冒险。”
一圈之后，安东内利在通往阿斯卡里弯的直道上轻松取得领先，并在终点线以3.8秒的优势顺利夺冠，成为自60年前卢多维科·斯卡尔菲奥蒂为法拉利夺冠以来，首位在蒙扎赢得大奖赛的意大利车手。
维斯塔潘获得第三名，落后拉塞尔10.8秒，成功抵挡住了迈凯伦车队在比赛后段发起的反击。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和兰多·诺里斯为第四名展开了一场激烈的争夺，并在还剩三圈时达到白热化——诺里斯冲进了砂石区，抱怨皮亚斯特里在大弯（Curva Grande）出口处把他挤出了赛道。
迈凯伦的指挥墙提醒车手要“干净地比赛”，但之后两人都各自冲出过赛道，直到比赛最后一圈，诺里斯才超越皮亚斯特里拿下第四名。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿最终位列第六，排在皮亚斯特里之后；他在比赛起步阶段与勒克莱尔的缠斗中冲出赛道，从第四位跌至第八位。他曾短暂向两辆迈凯伦发起挑战，但无法跟上他们的节奏，期间两次冲出赛道，从红旗出示到比赛结束，他一直使用的是中性胎。
阿尔派车手加斯利的杆位好景不长：他在第二圈被拉塞尔夺走领先位置，比赛重启后又逐渐被维斯塔潘、两辆迈凯伦、安东内利和汉密尔顿超越，最终守住第七名。
加斯利的队友科拉平托在比赛初期重启时速度很快，发车时一度击败维斯塔潘，但随后丢掉了位置，之后又冲出赛道，跌落到第16名。
不过科拉平托最终回升至第九名，落后小红牛车手、第八名的阿维德·林德布拉德两秒。
角田裕毅为小红牛以第10名完赛，但比赛结束时因起步程序违规正在接受调查；红旗之后，他没有停在自己的发车格内，导致不得不再次进行一圈编队行驶。
奥迪车手们错失了积分，博托莱托获得第11名，尼科·霍肯伯格获得第12名，后者在虚拟安全车期间进了站。
卡洛斯·塞恩斯也在虚拟安全车期间进站，最终为威廉姆斯获得第13名，排在红牛车手利亚姆·劳森之前。劳森在比赛早期因前翼损坏而损失了位置，被迫在第12圈进站，他还被出示了黑白旗。
奥利·比尔曼获得第15名，排在埃斯特班·奥康之前，前者本周末在蒙扎使用了升级版的法拉利动力单元，而他的哈斯队友则被迫等待。
亚历克斯·阿尔本获得第17名，排在两辆凯迪拉克之前，而两辆阿斯顿·马丁都没能撑到格子旗。
8 阿尔维德·林德布拉德（小红牛），落后45.136秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli was unstoppable at Monza as he won Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell and Red Bull's Max Verstappen.

Antonelli made up seven places before Charles Leclerc crashed out at the end of lap two, causing a red flag. Once the race resumed, Antonelli continued his charge right the way through to the front, swapping positions with Russell numerous times as the Mercedes battled for the lead.
But the championship leader gained a decision advantage when at the end of lap 28, while running second, he pitted under a virtual safety car - something Mercedes chose not to do with Russell.
Antonelli took the lead late on despite an off-track excursion, to become the first Italian to win their home race at Monza since 1966.
Also pitting under the VSC, Verstappen completed the podium having tailed the Mercedes drivers throughout the race.
Polesitter Pierre Gasly was ultimately defenceless and finished seventh for Alpine.
During the red flag for Leclerc's crash, Antonelli was one of a handful to choose medium tyres instead of hards for the restart - having taken the intial start on the hard compound.
The race restarted on lap six with Antonelli in 12th. He was up to sixth within a couple of laps, and by lap 14 he had closed up to the lead battle between Russell and Verstappen.
By lap 16, Russell had repassed Verstappen for the lead and, on that lap, Antonelli took second off the four-time champion - who had reported that his rear axle was "completely broken".

Antonelli and Russell then engaged in an F1 2026-style back-and-forth for the lead until, around lap 22, engineer Pete Bonington told Antonelli to 'stop yo-yoing', later detailing that Russell was being given time to build up a gap to Verstappen behind.
"If he can't do that, we’ll invert," Antonelli was told.

The team orders conundrum was waylaid on lap 28 after Lance Stroll's Aston Martin stopped to bring out the VSC. Antonelli and Verstappen pitted for mediums and hards, respectively - while Russell stayed out and would nurse his hard tyres to the end.
The pitting pair made easy work of the cars ahead from sixth and seventh, respectively. By lap 37, Antonelli was within 10 seconds of the lead; by lap 47 he was closing to within a second.
On lap 49 of 53, Antonelli attempted to pry the lead off Russell at the opening chicane but miscued, going into the gravel and losing 1.4 seconds.
"Keep it clean, no risks here," Russell was told as he continued on.

One lap later, Antonelli took the lead with ease on the run to Ascari and cruised to victory from there with a margin of 3.8s at the chequered flag, becoming the first Italian to win a grand prix at Monza since Ludovico Scarfiotti did so for Ferrari 60 years ago.
Verstappen finished third, 10.8s behind Russell, having seen off a late retaliatory attack from the McLarens.

Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris engaged in a spirited battle for fourth that came to a head with three laps remaining, when Norris took a trip into the gravel, complaining that Piastri had pushed him wide at the exit of Curva Grande.
"Clean racing" was the reminder from McLaren's pitwall but both would have their separate trips off the track later on before Norris passed Piastri for fourth on the final lap of the race.

Lewis Hamilton settled for sixth behind Piastri; he'd earlier run wide in battle with Leclerc at the start of the race and fallen from fourth to eighth. He briefly challenged the McLarens but could not keep up with them, going off the track twice as he stayed on medium tyres from the red flag to the end.

Alpine driver Gasly's pole position was short-lived: He lost the lead to Russell on the second lap and after the restart was gradually swallowed up by Verstappen, the McLarens, Antonelli and Hamilton before holding station in seventh.
Gasly’s team-mate Colapinto was rapid on the early race restart, beating Verstappen off the line before losing the place, then going off the track to fall down to 16th.
But Colapinto recovered to ninth, two seconds behind Racing Bulls's eighth-place driver Arvid Lindblad.

Yuki Tsunoda finished 10th for Racing Bulls but was under investigation at the end of the race for a starting procedure infringement; after the red flag, he missed his grid box and forced another formation lap to be taken.
The Audi drivers missed out on points with Gabriel Bortoleto 11th and Nico Hulkenberg 12th, the latter having pitted during the VSC.

Carlos Sainz also pitted under the VSC and finished 13th for Williams, ahead of Red Bull driver Liam Lawson. Lawson lost ground early on with a broken front wing that forced him to pit on lap 12, and he was also shown a black-and-white-flag.
Ollie Bearman finished 15th ahead of Esteban Ocon, the former having had the upgraded Ferrari power unit this weekend at Monza while his Haas team-mate was forced to wait.
Alex Albon finished 17th ahead of the Cadillacs, while neither Aston Martin made it to the chequered flag.
8 Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +45.136s

relatedItems.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒
他因驶入1号弯逃生通道导致能量输出模式混乱，15号弯后刹车失灵撞上护墙
佩雷兹在博塔斯撞车前几乎已经套圈
keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's
His car's deployment pattern got confused after he took the Turn 1 escape road, leaving his rear brakes without effect at Turn 15 where he nosed into the barriers
Perez was close to lapping Bottas before the Finn's crash on the final lap

relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.

relatedItems.summaryEn: Formula 1 will return to Sepang in 2026 after nearly a decade away, replacing the cancelled Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix, and drivers have been sharing their early predictions about the challenge ahead.
